validation_evidence.command: jq -e '.goal != "" and (.constraints | length > 0) and (.deliverables | length > 0) and (.risks | length > 0) and (.unknowns | length > 0)' intent.json
validation_evidence.summary: IntentSpec contém goal, constraints, deliverables, risks e unknowns com resoluções verificáveis. Custos de modelo não se aplicam ao gate local determinístico.
